caption: Our custom SEO title and meta description on a post, with the search preview. Both showed up in the page head after saving.
Step 3 of the setup wizard ticked extra installs by default: Broken Link Checker, MonsterInsights, OptinMonster, Universally and two Pro addons. We unticked each one.
Step 5 filled in the site admin email to connect the site to the AIOSEO SEO API, with usage sharing switched on. We skipped the step.
Pricing on 22 Nov 2026, shown in euros from the Netherlands: Basic at €49.50 for the first year for one site, normally €99.
The Basic checkout: €99.00 less a 50% discount plus 21% VAT, €59.90 in total, with a new AIOSEO account. We did not pay.
